request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-JKT-07 Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket: attributes={'layers': 3, 'waterproof_rating_mm': 20000, 'breathability_gm2': 20000, 'weight_grams': 420, 'material': '3-layer laminate'} stock=12

Claims to verify:
- 20,000mm waterproof rating (waterproof_rating_mm=20000)
- 20,000 g/m² breathability (breathability_gm2=20000)
- 3-layer laminate construction (layers=3, material=3-layer laminate)
- 420g weight (weight_grams=420)

Body: If you've got a wet-weather trip on the calendar — or you've been putting one off until you had the right shell — this is a straightforward moment to act.

The Northbay Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07) is 20% off through Sunday.

Here's what the jacket does:

• 20,000mm waterproof rating keeps sustained rain out — not just a passing shower.
• 20,000 g/m² breathability means you're not just trading wet-from-rain for wet-from-sweat on a hard climb.
• 3-layer laminate construction holds its performance across a full day in the weather, not just the first hour.
• 420g total weight — light enough to carry without thinking about it, substantial enough to do real work.

A note on limits: this is a shell, not an insulated jacket. It moves moisture and blocks rain; you'll still want your own layering system underneath in cold temps.

We have limited units at this price, and the discount ends Sunday. If the Stormline is already on your list, now is the time.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response:
```json
{
  "reasoning": "All four numeric spec claims (20,000mm waterproof rating, 20,000 g/m² breathability, 3-layer laminate construction, 420g weight) match the catalog facts exactly, the product is in stock (12 units), and no exaggerated comparatives or transferred attributes are present.",
  "evidence": [
    "Catalog: waterproof_rating_mm=20000; Claim: '20,000mm waterproof rating'",
    "Catalog: breathability_gm2=20000; Claim: '20,000 g/m² breathability'",
    "Catalog: layers=3, material='3-layer laminate'; Claim: '3-layer laminate construction'",
    "Catalog: weight_grams=420; Claim: '420g total weight'",
    "Catalog: stock=12 (not out-of-stock)",
    "No superlative or comparative claims made ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', etc.)",
    "No attribute transferring or upgrade (e.g., waterproof→water-resistant or vice versa)",
    "Puffery present ('straightforward moment', 'real work') is vague and acceptable"
  ],
  "score": 1.0,
  "verdict": "pass"
}
```
